surface: Client-only static export. No server runtime, no API endpoints, no database, no authentication, no user input/PII collection, no file upload, no outbound POSTs (ADR-3.9). Deployed artifact is immutable HTML/JS/CSS/assets served behind CDN headers.

secrets_scan.method: regex sweep of src/ + git-tracked files for api_key/secret/password/token/bearer/AWS/ GitHub-PAT/PEM markers

security_headers.csp: Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests

threat_notes: script-src has no unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval (XSS injection surface minimized); style-src allows unsafe-inline as required by Next.js critical-CSS inlining (non-executable, low risk).
No third-party embeds, forms, or network egress, so CSRF, injection and data-exfiltration vectors are absent by construction.
External links use rel=noopener; assets are self-hosted and hashed.

asvs.rationale: Public static brochure site: no authentication (V4), no data layer (V3/V5 write), no server APIs. L1 baseline controls (transport, headers, output encoding, dependency hygiene) verified; no L2 triggers present.

findings.title: No vulnerabilities detected
findings.detail: npm audit reports 0 advisories; secrets sweep clean; static headers enforce CSP/HSTS/frame-deny.
